title: 2005 AMC 10A Problem 1
statement: While eating out, Mike and Joe each tipped their server \(\$2.\) Mike tipped \(10\%\) of his bill and Joe tipped \(20\%\) of his bill. What was the difference, in dollars, between their bills?

solutions.text:
Mike’s \(\$2\) tip is \(10\%\) of his bill, so his bill is \(2 \times 10 = 20\) dollars. Joe’s \(\$2\) tip is \(20\%\) of his bill, so his bill is \(2 \times 5 = 10\) dollars. The difference is \(20 - 10 = 10\) dollars.

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: A tip equal to \(10\%\) of a bill means the bill is \(10\) times the tip
Recover each bill from its tip, then subtract
